correctness.rationale: The one-coordinate unit normalization preserves both collision equations, and invertibility justifies the exact factorization into (1+t)(r-1)(r-t)=0. The three residue regimes t≡1,-1,other mod p are disjoint and exhaustive because p is odd. Each p-adic root count and valuation multiplicity is proved for every k; the sum simplifies for both exponent parities, with CRT handling all odd moduli. The Fourier equality follows from full-character orthogonality. A standalone enumeration independently passed 16 prime-power and 18 composite moduli, with 1496 normalized root checks. Finite tests are not extrapolated.

value.rationale: Additive energy is the precise fourfold collision statistic for a classical modular hyperbola and equals the complete fourth Kloosterman moment. The direct 2016 literature bound only controls its order O(kφ(p^k)^2); an unexpectedly simple exact identity E/φ²=3k-3/(p-1) settles every odd prime power, with an Euler product for all odd moduli. This answers a structurally motivated natural invariant, not a finite table slice.
